name: driver_entry_get_active_buffer_offset
desc: Driver jump table entry: get active audio buffer offset
details: Entry point 3 in the driver dispatch table at offset 000Fh. Performs a far jump to sb_get_active_buffer_offset (0823:1060), which returns the base offset of the currently active double-buffer (0x001F or 0x061F) in DI.

ret.name: buf_offset
ret.desc: Base offset of active audio buffer within the CS segment (0x001F or 0x061F)
